method.specimen_dimensions: 3 × 5 × 20 mm3,source order retained;no axis assignment invented
method.strain_amplitude: 0.2% as written;source does not specify peak/RMS/peak-to-peak convention
method.criterion: tanδ maximum in section3.4,not storage-modulus onset,loss-modulus maximum or DSC inflection
method.pan_geometry: not applicable as DSC pan information;no DMA clamp detail inferred

count_adjudication_requested.proposal: Record exact common-method triplication separately;keep selected scalar sample_count null unless independent review finds sufficient selected-result group linkage.
count_adjudication_requested.reason: Table3 reports one Tg per formulation without defining aggregation,per-repeat results or contributing trace identity. A method repeat statement need not establish three distinct specimens or a mean.
count_adjudication_requested.not_a_claim: This does not deny triplication or state that no specimens were tested.

preparation_boundary.known: Formulations extruded per section2.3. DMA uses rectangular bars of source dimensions. Reactive-series precursor DCP/acetone drying is preparation background only.
preparation_boundary.unresolved: Post-extrusion route of the exact DMA bars is not explicitly linked;do not assume they came from hot-pressed120°C discs or injection-molded tensile route merely because section2.3 mentions these routes.

quantity_scope_proposal.reason: Existing signed-coordinate and catalogue-only validators are not restricted to an instrument family;the current descriptive documentation discusses DSC only. Extend documentation to preserve method-qualified DMA context without treating Tg as a unique interchangeable material constant.

distinct DMA state and property IDs

source_discrepancies.description: Section3.5 opening includes Tg among DSC thermal properties,while section3.4 and Table3 explicitly assign these selected Tg values from DMA tanδ maxima.
source_discrepancies.disposition: Use the explicit DMA method/Table3/section3.4 chain for this batch;preserve the inconsistent general DSC wording instead of treating these cells as DSC measurements.
